title: ResonanceSuppressor, scan workflow, processBlock wiring, CMakeLists
description:
Implement six ResonanceSuppressor dynamic-notch slots, scan workflow glue producing candidate cards, wire SpectralAnalysisEngine + ResonanceDetector + suppressor into PluginProcessor, and register phase-G sources in CMakeLists.txt. This task is the sole owner of PluginProcessor.* and CMakeLists.txt for phase G.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §8.5–8.7 (six suppressor nodes and controls; scan workflow; removed-signal audition y_removed = x - y_processed)
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §18.5 (scan off audio thread; results via atomic/message-thread transfer)
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §19.1 (default 0 samples latency for resonance suppression)
- Source/Analysis/SpectralAnalysisEngine.* and AnalysisFifo.* public APIs from g.1 (read only except wiring includes)
- Source/DSP/ResonanceDetector.* candidate API from g.2 (read only except wiring)
- Source/DSP/PitchDetector.* latest f0 snapshot API from phase F (read only; feed detector)
- Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp prepareToPlay/processBlock order from prior phases
- Source/ParameterIDs.h resonance/scan related IDs if present (read only)
- CMakeLists.txt target_sources patterns from phases B–F (append only)

Implement Source/DSP/ResonanceSuppressor.h and Source/DSP/ResonanceSuppressor.cpp:
1. Exactly six suppressor slots (v1.0; comment expandable to eight in v1.1). Each slot: enable, center frequency 150 Hz–16 kHz, Q 3–40, max depth 0–18 dB, attack 0.5–100 ms, release 20–2000 ms, persistence requirement 0–100%, static vs dynamic mode, stereo placement, confidence, freeze, solo, removed-signal audition flags per §8.5.
2. Dynamic notch filters (modulation-stable TPT/biquad style consistent with existing project filters) or static notches; process stereo (or M/S placement where stereo placement requires) without heap in process().
3. prepare/reset/processBlock-safe process: smoothed frequency/gain/Q; depth may follow detector activity/persistence in dynamic mode or hold fixed attenuation in static mode; freeze holds coefficients/depth.
4. Solo and removed-signal audition: y_removed[n] = x[n] - y_processed[n] availability for selected slots / module-level audition without breaking dry path when disabled.
5. applyCandidate / loadFromCandidate helpers to create dynamic or static notch from a ResonanceCandidate (bounds clamp depth/Q/freq).
6. True bypass when module or all slots disabled — no residual notches.

Scan workflow (in Suppressor and/or thin processor-owned helper still within allowed files):
1. User Scan: begin scan for configurable duration; analysis continues off audio thread via existing engine/detector; on end, expose candidate cards for audition/reject/create dynamic notch/create static notch/reduce depth/classify intentional/exclusion-list hooks (data structures + APIs; full GUI later).
2. Never auto-apply notches to the audible path until an explicit apply/accept API is invoked.
3. Bounded card list fixed max; rejection/exclusion stored in fixed-capacity containers.

Wire Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp:
1. Own SpectralAnalysisEngine (+ ensure AnalysisFifo path), ResonanceDetector, ResonanceSuppressor members (by value preferred).
2. prepareToPlay/releaseResources/reset: prepare all three; start/stop analyzer thread with engine enabled state; no audio-thread FFT planning.
3. processBlock: push audio (and optional sidechain tap storage if already available) into AnalysisFifo; feed PitchDetector f0 snapshot into ResonanceDetector on a control tick or message-adjacent path already used for pitch; run ResonanceSuppressor on the audible path at zero added latency; honor global bypass and module enable.
4. Drive scan begin/end from parameters/flags if ParameterIDs already define them; otherwise expose clear processor methods for future UI without inventing host automation spam.
5. Document insertion point relative to existing TightCut / Chug / parametric / multiband stages; choose one coherent position for suppressor (typically late correction stage after main tone EQ unless IDs dictate otherwise).

CMakeLists.txt:
1. Append Source/Analysis/AnalysisFifo.cpp, Source/Analysis/SpectralAnalysisEngine.cpp, Source/DSP/ResonanceDetector.cpp, Source/DSP/ResonanceSuppressor.cpp to plugin/DSP targets.
2. Append tests/ResonanceTests.cpp to the test target (g.4 owns test body).
3. Append-only minimal edits — no preset/target rename churn.

Do not implement unit test bodies. verification_commands left empty.
acceptance_criteria: Source/DSP/ResonanceSuppressor.h and Source/DSP/ResonanceSuppressor.cpp exist with six suppressor slots exposing §8.5 controls (freq, Q, depth, attack, release, persistence, static/dynamic, placement, freeze, solo, audition)
ResonanceSuppressor process applies bounded dynamic/static notches with smoothed parameters, true bypass when disabled, and removed-signal audition support y_removed = x - y_processed
Scan workflow APIs accumulate ResonanceDetector candidates off the audio thread and never audible-apply notches until explicit accept/apply

Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp own SpectralAnalysisEngine, ResonanceDetector, and ResonanceSuppressor; push audio to the analysis FIFO from processBlock; run suppressor on the audible path at zero added latency; feed PitchDetector f0 into the detector path
CMakeLists.txt lists AnalysisFifo.cpp, SpectralAnalysisEngine.cpp, ResonanceDetector.cpp, ResonanceSuppressor.cpp, and tests/ResonanceTests.cpp on the correct targets
No heap allocation / mutex waits / FFT on the audio thread in the wired path
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: broad CMake restructure or rename plugin targets
enable auto-apply of scan candidates without explicit accept API
introduce non-zero default latency for resonance suppression

allowed: embed engine/detector/suppressor by value on the processor
reuse existing project TPT or biquad notch building blocks inside suppressor slots
control-rate detector tick from processor timer/callback or engine thread completion hook
append-only CMake target_sources for phase-G files
explicit applyCandidate path only for audible notches
forbidden: heap allocate per block for notches or candidates
percentile cloud / headroom histogram full GUI analyzers (later phases)
auto-engage all scan candidates into slots without user apply
